content: Pydantic v2 has a built-in AwareDatetime type that raises a 'timezone_aware' ValidationError when a naive datetime is provided; combine with field_validator/AfterValidator to additionally enforce UTC offset (utcoffset() == timedelta(0)) or normalize to UTC via astimezone(timezone.utc). Known gotcha: yyyy-MM-DD date-only strings pass AwareDatetime validation without error in 2.6+ despite lacking tz info.
